Acme pricing:
Start with a free plan

Frequently asked questions

The free plan allows you to create a Acme account, import or sync your contacts and activity data, use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports. On this tier you are limited to up to 250 active profiles (contacts who may receive marketing emails) and 500 email sends per month. Additionally, the free tier includes $5 of mobile messages per month (region/carrier dependent).

Yes – the free plan is available at no monthly cost as long as your account remains under the limits of 250 active profiles and 500 monthly email sends. However, if you exceed those limits (or require paid-plan features such as custom branding removal or advanced support) you will need to upgrade or your sending may be paused.

You may remain on the free plan indefinitely as long as your active profile count remains at or below the 250-profile limit and your monthly sends stay at or below 500 emails. Once you have exceeded either threshold, your ability to send may be restricted. Note: With the free plan you receive full email support only for the first 60 days; after that you still have access to the Help Centre, community resources and training but not full support channels reserved for paid tiers.

The free plan is best suited for small businesses, start-ups, or brands just getting started with marketing automation who have relatively small contact lists (≤250 active profiles) and moderate sending needs (≤500 emails/month). It allows you to test Acme's platform, integrate your data, run automations, and experiment with segmentation and SMS without paying upfront. As your audience, sends or sophistication grow, you'll likely need to transition to a paid tier.

Yes—the free plan supports both email marketing and text (SMS/MMS) marketing to a degree. On the free plan you are allotted $5 of mobile messages per month, so you can test mobile messaging campaigns.

Yes—the free plan includes $5 of mobile messages per month, enabling you to send mobile messages in addition to email.

The free plan supports the standard library of integrations (for example ecommerce platforms, CRMs, data sources) that Acme offers. You are not blocked from connecting your tech stack just because you’re on the free tier. Many third-party reviewers note that Acme’s core integrations are included.

Once you have exceeded the free plan’s limits (e.g. more than 250 active profiles or more than 500 email sends in a month), your account will no longer be able to send additional emails or messages until the next billing cycle or until you upgrade to a paid plan. You’ll be prompted to upgrade to continue sending.

Yes, but with limitations: free plan users receive email support for the first 60 days after sign-up. After that, you’ll have access to the Acme Community and self-service resources (Help Centre, Academy) rather than full support channels reserved for paid tiers.

Yes – the free plan can absolutely work for ecommerce stores (on Shopify, WooCommerce, Sitebuilder, etc.) that are just starting out, testing email + SMS or sending to smaller audiences. Because Acme supports integrations with major ecommerce platforms and gives you access to segmentation and automation even on the free plan, it’s a useful entry point. As your store and list grow (beyond the 250-contact limit or high-volume sends), you’ll want to move to a paid tier.

Upgrading from the free plan is straightforward: in your Acme account, head to Account Settings → Billing (or Change Plan), review your active profile count and required sends, select the paid tier that matches your needs and complete the upgrade. Once upgraded, your account unlocks paid-plan features (no send or profile limits on that tier), plus enhanced support, branding removal, etc.
